mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% over the next month raises investor expectations for future rate hikes, which reduces the present value of future cash flows and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL > 2% for 3 consecutive months, or inflation decays rapidly (second difference < -0.5% monthly).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PAYEMS labor cost index (≥ 2% over 2 months) indicates strong wage growth, which raises firms' cost-of-capital and dampens equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥ 2% over the next 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive and statistically significant (t-test p < 0.05) when PAYEMS growth < 2% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 3% signals weakening demand momentum, which reduces expected corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by ≥ 3% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in 80% of GDPC1 contraction months, or GDPC1 recovers > 2% monthly within 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp upturn in INDPRO manufacturing index (≥ 4% over 1 month) suggests supply-side expansion, lowering marginal costs and boosting equity valuations, which is associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by ≥ 4% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO > 4% for 3 months, or SPX volatility spikes without mean reversion.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, the immediate discount rate effect outweighs equity price sensitivity, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.5 pp in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in 4 out of 5 months following such FEDFUNDS moves, or the 5-day return is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE unemployment (crossing below 5.0%) creates labor market optimism, lowering risk aversion and pushing S&P 500 20-day forward returns to the positive.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in 60% of UNRATE < 5.0% months, or the return is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST retail sales of > 3% signal resilient consumer demand, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by > 3% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive in 70% of such HOUST up months, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-proxy interaction between INDPRO and RSAFS (both rising by > 2% in the same month) indicates dual supply-side expansion, reinforcing equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: Both INDPRO and RSAFS increase by > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in 60% of such joint up months, or the interaction p-value exceeds 0.1 in a Granger causality test.
